title: Schedule
summary: Here you will find details on where to find us in person at various upcoming events, tradeshows and conferences.
body_markdown:
Here you will find details on where to find us in person at various upcoming events, tradeshows and conferences.


###


OVIN Partner Forum


###


- Oct 7


A Palitronica representative will be at the


**University of Toronto** on October 7th for the Ontario Vehicle Innovation Network (OVIN) Partner Forum.


Find out more about OVIN


[here](https://www.ovinhub.ca/) .


###


**Hydro-** Québec


###


-


**Oct 7-8** ****


Palitronica's Co-founder and Chief Strategy Officer, Sebastian, will be delivering a presentation on Infrastructure at the Hydro-Québec 2026 in


**Montreal, Quebec** , on October 7th-8th.


Learn more about Hydro-Québec


[here](https://www.hydroquebec.com/) .


###


AUSA Annual Meeting & Exposition – Oct 12-14


A few Palitronica executives will be attending the AUSA Annual Meeting & Exposition in


**Washington, DC** , on October 12–14, connecting with defence leaders, technology providers, and industry stakeholders from across the US defence ecosystem.


More info to come on how to book a time to meet with us at AUSA


**Polytechnique Montréal – Oct 15-16**


Palitronica’s Co-founder, Sebastian Fischmeister, will be presenting at Polytechnique Montréal in


**Montreal, Quebec,** on October 15-16.


More details to follow.


****


**Best Defence Conference**


**– Oct 20-21**


Palitronica will be exhibiting at the Best Defence Conference in


**London, ON** , on October 20–21, connecting with organizations and leaders across Canada’s defence sector.


Find our more about the conference


[here](https://bestdefenceconference.com/) .


More info to come on how to book a time to meet with us at this conference


**CyberPUCV – Oct 22**


Palitronica’s Co-founder, Sebastian Fischmeister, will deliver a keynote at CyberPUCV at the Chilean Naval Academy in


**Valparaíso, Chile** , while also meeting with Chilean government and military representatives to discuss cybersecurity and supply-chain security.


**IEEE PAINE Conference – Oct 27-29**


Palitronica will be participating in the IEEE International Conference on Physical Assurance and Inspection of Electronics (PAINE) in


**Phoenix, Arizona** , from October 27–29. Co-founder Sebastian Fischmeister will present papers, deliver presentations, and showcase posters as part of the conference program.


Find out more about the event


[here](https://paine-conference.org/) .


More info to come on how to book a time to meet with us at this conference


#####


Electronica – Nov 10-13


Palitronica’s CEO Matthew Monteyne, will be attending the annual electronica in


**Munich, Germany** , from November 10–13, connecting with manufacturers, suppliers, and technology leaders from across the global electronics industry.


Learn more about the event


[here](https://electronica.de/en/trade-fair/) .


More info to come on how to book a time to meet with us at electronica


**INCYBER Forum – Dec 1-3**


Palitronica’s Co-founder, Sebastian Fischmeister, will be exhibiting at Canada's INCYBER Forum in


**Ottawa, ON,** from December 1–3, connecting with cybersecurity leaders, organizations, and industry experts from across Canada.


Find out more about the event


[here](https://www.linkedin.com/company/incyberforum-canada/home/) .


More info to come on how to book a time to meet with us at InCyber


Stay tuned as we continue to update as more details become available.
